summary: Two open compilations that likely pair a first-cross barrier with a postzygotic barrier exist: the Turelli et al. Drosophila speciation dataset (CC0, two CSVs) and the 89-pair seed-plant reproductive isolation table (CC0, one CSV). I could not read their columns (Dryad anonymous downloads returned 401, and I only used metadata), so whether both variables are given per pair is unconfirmed; the Drosophila postzygotic variable is described as dichotomised, which limits a correlation.
next_step: Download both CSVs through a browser and check for per-pair premating and F1 fertility columns; if the Drosophila index is binary, consider the plant table or the Coyne & Orr 1989/1997 source tables.
obstacles_confirmed: Open numerical compilation is essentially Drosophila.
Pairs that fail at the first cross cannot be assayed for hybrid sterility.
